title: Microsoft Teams: App Deployment in Teams Admin Center
description: We're introducing a new admin setting that replaces the Installed apps section in app setup policies, enabling more streamlined per-app deployment control.  With controls to pre-install the app for : all users, specific users and groups, or no users.
